card.name: Business Card Intelligence
card.tagline: Turn business cards into verified, exportable contacts.

auth.name: Display name
auth.registrationClosed: Sign-up is closed. Ask the administrator for an account.

confidence.label: Confidence
confidence.disclaimer: Confidence is a model estimate, not a guarantee of correctness.

upload.formats: JPEG, PNG, WEBP or TIFF · max {{mb}} MB
upload.phoneWaiting: Take the photo with your phone…
upload.phoneWaitingHint: On the phone (same account): app → “Camera for the PC”, or website → “Phone camera”. The photo will appear here.

process.languagesHint: Leave all selected for mixed documents.
process.rerunWarning: Re-running replaces the extracted values. Your previous corrections stay in the history.
process.reused: Identical images were already processed; showing that result.

ocr.notice: Recognised text is shown exactly as read. It is never translated or rewritten.
ocr.translationNote: Machine-generated translation — not part of the record.
ocr.translationUnavailable: Machine translation is not configured on this server.

list.deleteSelectedBody: They disappear from the list and the mobile app, and are permanently erased after the retention period.

delete.title: Delete this record?
delete.body: The record and its images will be removed. This cannot be undone after the retention period.

settings.title: Settings
settings.phoneRegionHint: Used only to interpret numbers without an international prefix (e.g. MA, FR). Leave empty to never assume a country.
settings.privacyText: Images and text are processed on this server. No external AI service is used unless an administrator enables one.
settings.androidHint: Shown as the “Android app” button in the header. Leave empty to use the server default.
settings.ownerOnly: Only the workspace owner can change this link.
settings.privacyTextCloud: Card images and their text are sent to Ollama Cloud (Gemma model) for reading and extraction; data is stored in the project's database and storage.

errors.network_error: Cannot reach the server. Check your connection and retry.
errors.email_taken: An account with this e-mail already exists.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute.
errors.unsupported_type: This file type is not supported. Use JPEG, PNG, WEBP or TIFF.
errors.type_mismatch: The file content does not match its type.
errors.corrupt_image: The image could not be read.
errors.image_too_small: The image is too small to contain readable text.
errors.malware_detected: The file was rejected by the malware scanner.
errors.no_images: Upload at least one image first.
errors.ocr_engine_unavailable: The OCR engine is not available on the server. Nothing was recognised.
errors.version_conflict: Someone else changed this record. Reload to see the latest version.
errors.invalid_email: This e-mail address is not valid.
errors.invalid_url: This URL is not valid (http/https only).
errors.invalid_phone: This phone number is not valid.
errors.schema_validation_failed: The change does not fit the record format.

onboarding.step1Text: Photograph the document or drop a scan. Perspective and rotation are corrected automatically.
onboarding.step2Text: Arabic, French and English text is read line by line, even when mixed.
onboarding.step3Text: Check highlighted fields, correct what is uncertain, then export.

warnings.llm_requested_but_not_configured: Language-model extraction was requested but is not configured.
warnings.ocr_correction: An obvious OCR confusion was corrected in the structured address (l → I in a Roman numeral); the original OCR text is unchanged.
warnings.qr_conflict: The QR code disagrees with the printed card — see the QR section.
warnings.qr_value_not_on_card: The QR code contains contact data that is not printed on the card — see the QR section.
warnings.possible_partial_text: Some text looks partly hidden or cut off; a fragment was not used as a value.
warnings.llm_rejected_invalid: {{field}}: the AI's value is not valid (e.g. a non-existent number) and was not kept.
warnings.llm_rejected_not_in_ocr_text: {{field}}: the AI's value is not printed on the card and was not kept.
warnings.llm_rejected_other: {{field}}: the AI's value was not kept.
warnings.cloud_ocr_repaired: The model's answer was repaired automatically (format).

card.mergeConfirm: Merge the selected record into this contact? The other record will be deleted. Empty fields are filled; nothing is overwritten.
card.qrUnsafe: Not a safe web link — shown as text only.
card.qrNote: QR content is data from the card. Review it before importing.
card.empty: No contacts yet. Scan a business card to begin.
card.batchHint: Drop several single-sided cards; each becomes its own contact.
card.qrConflictNote: The QR code and the printed text disagree. Nothing was changed automatically; choose the correct value.

notes.no_hw: No verified handwriting recognizer is installed.
notes.academic: Academic/medical title printed before the name
notes.llm: Suggested by a language model; grounded in OCR evidence
notes.inferred_doctor: Inferred from “{{v}}” and the printed medical specialty — not printed as a title; please confirm
notes.possible_fragment: Possibly a partly hidden fragment of {{v}}

usage.title: Usage and limits
usage.noLimit: Limit not published by the provider — set LIMIT_OLLAMA_REQUESTS_* to show a gauge.
usage.note: Measured from the application's own data (providers do not expose their quotas). Vercel: requests ≤ {{mb}} MB, processing ≤ {{s}} s.
usage.ollamaWeekHint: Ollama Cloud free usage resets weekly. Estimated, adjustable limit (LIMIT_OLLAMA_REQUESTS_WEEK); the exact percentage is on ollama.com → Usage.

phone.title: Phone as camera
phone.sendHint: Shoot cards one after another: each card is sent immediately and shows up on your PC (same account).
phone.listening: Listening — cards sent from your phone appear here
phone.receiveHint: On your phone, signed in to the same account, open this address (or the “Phone camera” menu):
